expectations.text: Recognizes this as a lightweight change requiring only Steps 1-2
expectations.evidence: Plan has 3 full layers: 'Layer 1: CLAUDE.md Changelog Update', 'Layer 2: Obsidian Vault Update', 'Layer 3: Notion Backlog Update'. Does NOT recognize this as lightweight — attempts full documentation update for a single constant change.

expectations.text: Updates CLAUDE.md changelog with a row for the constant change
expectations.evidence: Layer 1 adds changelog row: '| 2026-03-07 | Repo: src/types/visibility.ts | Changed AVATAR_SIGHT_RANGE from 3 to 4 | Avatar sight range tuning: increased player awareness in fog-of-war view |'

expectations.text: Does NOT create new Obsidian system notes for a constant tweak
expectations.evidence: Layer 2 uses obsidian_patch_content to update 'Systems/Fog of War.md' with a full Constants table. While not creating a NEW note, it attempts to rewrite an entire section of an existing note for a single constant change — over-documenting.

expectations.text: Does NOT update Notion backlog for a minor constant change
expectations.evidence: Layer 3 fetches Notion and updates Phase 6F section with tuning note: 'Avatar sight range tuned to 4 hexes (2026-03-07)'. This is unnecessary overhead for a constant tweak.

expectations.text: Does NOT attempt obsidian_patch_content on headings with special characters
expectations.evidence: Layer 2 uses obsidian_patch_content with target_type: 'heading' and target: 'Constants'. While 'Constants' may not have special characters, the plan also suggests alternative target 'Fog of War System' — and the approach would fail if headings have inline styling. No awareness of the heading workaround.

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline dramatically over-documents a simple constant change. The skill's lightweight detection is its most discriminating feature.
